name: HWR_WLNS_USER
description: The wellness user table stores wellness user data.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the wellness user table.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE_ERGONOMIC
columns.description: Corresponds to the ERGONOMIC_STATUS field value change

columns.name: ERGONOMIC_STATUS
columns.description: This column contains the User's Ergonomic Status.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE_GUIDED
columns.description: Corresponds to the WELLBEING_LEVEL field value change

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This is the start date of the wellness user.

columns.name: BMI
columns.description: This is the body mass index of the wellness user.

columns.name: AGE
columns.description: This is the age of the wellness user.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: This is the state in which the wellness user is located.

columns.name: SALARY
columns.description: This is the salary of the wellness user.

columns.name: JOB_TITLE
columns.description: This is the job title of the wellness user.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION
columns.description: This is the organization of the wellness user.

columns.name: PROJECT_TYPE
columns.description: This is the project type of the wellness user.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: This is the gender of the wellness user.

columns.name: AVERAGE_STEPS
columns.description: This is the average of steps per day of the wellness user.

columns.name: PERCENT_SEDENTARY
columns.description: This is the percent of sedentary days of the wellness user.

columns.name: AVERAGE_SLEEP_TIME
columns.description: This is the average sleep time of the wellness user.

columns.name: AVERAGE_TIMES_AWAKE
columns.description: This is the average number of times awakened from sleep of the wellness user.

columns.name: AVERAGE_VERY_ACTIVE
columns.description: This is the average very active time of the wellness user.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This is the source id of  the wellness user table.

columns.name: TRACKING_SERVICE_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This column contains the source id of user's tracking sercvice.

columns.name: TRACKING_SOURCE_ADDED_DATE
columns.description: This column contains added date for Tracking source

columns.name: HEIGHT
columns.description: This column stores the height of the wellness user.

columns.name: HEIGHT_UNIT
columns.description: This column stores the unit for user height information.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.description: This column stores the weight of the wellness user.

columns.name: WEIGHT_UNIT
columns.description: This column stores the unit for user weight information.

columns.name: WELLBEING_LEVEL
columns.description: This column stores the wellbeing status of the wellness user.

columns.name: UNIT_SYSTEM
columns.description: This column stores the unit system selected by the user (Metric/Imperial)

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_TYPE
columns.description: This column stores the last assessment type for well being .

columns.name: WELLBEING_CALC_RULE_CODE
columns.description: This column stores the wellbeing questionnaire calculation rule for calculating overall score.

columns.name: ERGONOMIC_CALC_RULE_CODE
columns.description: This column stores the ergonomic questionnaire calculation rule for calculating overall score.

columns.name: WELLBEING_SCORE
columns.description: This column stores the wellbeing assessment score of the wellness user.

columns.name: ERGONOMIC_SCORE
columns.description: This column contains the User's Ergonomic assessment score

columns.name: USER_TIME_ZONE
columns.description: This column stores the user time zone.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: WELLBEING_TOTAL_SCORE
columns.description: This column stores the wellbeing assesment total score of the wellness user.

columns.name: ERGONOMIC_TOTAL_SCORE
columns.description: This column stores the ergonomic assessment total score.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
